title: audio.pcm.decode result
description: What the region holds, as a bounded waveform envelope beside the digest of the bytes it was read from.

offset.description: Byte offset the region was read from.

sample_rate.description: The rate the request stated, echoed back beside the pinned bytes so the claim is checkable.

region_sha256.description: Digest of exactly the bytes the request selected, so two guesses at the same sample can be compared without holding either.

envelope.description: One min/max pair per waveform column. Both extremes, not an average: averaging a waveform toward zero is how a loud sample ends up looking like silence.
